plain_english: When you walk, you watch out for nails on the ground or twisting your ankle. Do the same thing with your mind — protect the part of you that makes decisions. If you guarded your mind this carefully in everything you do, you'd act with much more safety.
original_excerpt: As in walking you take care not to tread upon a nail, or turn your foot, so likewise take care not to hurt the ruling faculty of your mind. And if we were to guard against this in every action, we should enter upon action more safely.
